description.en:
Improvement addon for Precision Farming. Requires FS25_precisionFarming.
- Grass rolling counts as mechanical (chemical-free) weed control in the environmental score - Mulching counts as mechanical weed control - Slurry, digestate and manure apply nitrogen up to the crop's target level instead of a fixed rate - New "Crop Rotation" environmental score category: rotating crops (and growing legumes) is rewarded, monoculture is penalised - Environmental score now scales sale prices from 50% (score 0) through 100% (score 50) up to 120% (score 100)
